about: USBPcap, the USB capture driver Wireshark uses on Windows, for Tools > Vendor apps > USB capture (tools/usbcap.py, docs/USB_CAPTURE.md). The Windows package carries the official installer unmodified at 'path' and its complete source at 'sourcePath' (GPL-2.0 section 3); make_package.py --python downloads both from 'url' / 'sourceUrl' and checks the SHA-256s, smoke_package.py checks them in the zip, usbcap.install() checks the installer again before it starts it (ShellExecute runas: Windows' prompt, then USBPcap's own installer pages; never silent). Licences: the driver GPL-2.0, USBPcapCMD BSD-2-Clause (texts in licenses/, NOTICE names them). Version 1.5.4.0 is the latest release and the one Wireshark's own Windows build pins (same SHA-256). The installer is Authenticode-signed by 'signer' (Certum Code Signing CA SHA2, timestamped). A newer USBPcap: change every field together and run tools/test_usbcap.py plus the package smoke tests.
